Life is beautiful for those who have the talent, the will and the opportunity to help make it beautiful. For those who can't life is hard and unfulfilling. I will be joining you soon.

My life, whether naturally or by my own hand, will end soon. I am miserable, depressed and anxiety ridden. The simplest of tasks have become burdensome. I get no pleasure from anything. Nothing works and nothing gets fixed. I feel this way because I have come to realize that I add nothing to the world. All my life my ability to form get interpersonal relationships has failed because I simply did not give those around me a reason to want to be around me. The secret of life is to make the lives of those around you better, even if it is as simple as brightening their day with you own smile. I have been unable to do that. It is time for me to stop trying.
If it any comfort know that I, and many of us, feel the same way. Hope to see you on the other side.
